exhibitions_entry.name: Moravian Gallery in Brno
exhibitions_entry.description: The Czech Republic's second-largest art museum, spanning old masters to contemporary art across five Brno buildings. Its poster and graphic design holdings, built around the Brno Graphic Design Biennale, are among the finest in Europe.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 체코에서 두 번째로 큰 미술관으로, 브르노 시내 다섯 채의 건물에서 고전 회화부터 현대미술까지 아우른다. 브르노 그래픽디자인 비엔날레와 함께 쌓아 온 포스터·그래픽디자인 컬렉션으로 특히 이름 높다.

notes: Platform is shared with UPM Prague — filter[gallery]='Moravská galerie, MG' is mandatory (46,760 MG vs 55,188 total; 46,493 with images). KEY CONSTRAINT: Elasticsearch 10k result window (HTTP 500 past from+size=10,000) — script bisects filter[date_earliest][gte/lt] ranges into slices ≤9,000 (covers all 34,316 dated items) plus small work_type/technique/medium subsets (each ≤9k total, nulls sort last so fully reachable) to recover most of the 12,177 null-dated items; null-dated items without a parseable year are dropped by the min-4 rule anyway. Scope via MG inventory prefixes: A/Z=paintings, B/SDK=drawings, C/MM=prints, GD/ARN=graphic design dept ('poster' category, Brno Biennale goldmine), GDR=ex libris ('print'), JV=Jiří Valoch conceptual works on paper; OUT: U(applied 3D), E(sculpture), ST/BF(books). In-scope offered ~28k > CAP 25,000 — paintings/drawings/prints/JV kept fully, posters ranked by museum's own view_count fill the rest. Images capped at 800px by the server (1200+ returns 404; IIP server iip.offgridlab.sk rejects direct access 403). MG's famous photography collection is NOT on this platform yet (work_type fotografia = UPM-only). Colorfulness<20 gate applied ONLY to category 'print'. Resume: scripts/.state/moravian-gallery-{progress.json,items.ndjson,uploaded.ndjson,failed.ndjson}. author name_formatted gives natural 'First Last' order; 96% author fill in modern slices.
